title: Chapter 2940 - 172: Yin and Yang 3
content:
Chapter 2940: Chapter 172: Yin and Yang 3

Mo Hua slowly opened his eyes.

As his eyes opened and closed, it was as if the ancient "Spiritual Beast" awakened, gazing at the world for the first time.

"It’s a success..."

Even though Mo Hua’s divinity had reached its peak, and his humanity was already very faint, he still could not suppress a trace of joy emerging from the depths of his heart.

This wasn’t merely a joy arising from humanity due to the creation of the Lifebound Formation and the paving of the Core Formation path.

It was more a pleasure from his divinity, stemming from a yearning for the Dao and Law.

Mo Hua could feel the sensation of the Taotie’s law incubating and growing within his body, with the formation as the medium, since he had formed the Lifebound Formation.

Even deities find it hard to refuse this delight in ancient "laws."

And thus, the most difficult, dangerous, and crucial part of Mo Hua’s Lifebound Formation can be considered successfully inscribed.

Mo Hua let out a slow breath.

The next step was to use the "Wood Revitalization Formation" to lock in the blood.

Besides compensating for the damage to Blood Qi when inscribing the bones, this Wood Formation also serves as a foundation and means of ensuring survival.

The Taotie Spirit Formation is a fierce beast Ultimate Formation, extremely domineering and dangerous.

If the Taotie Spirit Formation goes out of control, overloads, or becomes chaotic, causing a breakdown.

Then Mo Hua’s internal meridians, bones, viscera, etc., which fuse with the Taotie Formation, would suffer severe damage and be difficult to repair.

Without corresponding means of "locking blood" and "replenishing vitality," the consequences are unimaginable.

Therefore, he must construct an internal "vitality" formation to compensate for the Blood Qi.

And to some extent, offset the risk of physical damage due to "out of control" Taotie Spirit Formation in the future.

Only then can nothing be left to chance.

Among Mo Hua’s options, only the "Wood Revitalization Formation" met all these requirements.

This is almost his best and only choice.

Fortunately, the formation patterns of the "Wood Revitalization Formation" are not difficult, at least far simpler than the twenty-four patterns of the Taotie Spirit Remains Formation.

Mo Hua used the essence of Wood White as Spiritual Ink to inscribe the Wood Revitalization Formation near his Twelve regular meridians, alongside the Taotie Spirit Remains Formation.

He had quite a few bones in his body.

Major areas were inscribed with the Taotie Formation, while Mo Hua filled the remaining empty spaces with the Wood Revitalization Formation.

Yet the casual supplementation led to a problem.

It was unclear whether it was the issue with this "Mo" Wood White essence, the method of forging bones with Wood White Gold Jade, or the ancient law contained within the Taotie Spirit Remains Formation.

When Mo Hua inscribed the Wood Revitalization Formation on his bones, certain "reactions" suddenly occurred.

Patterns of the Wood Formation began to twist, as if some "Illusionary Realm" shattered, shifting to something different.

Vaguely, Mo Hua seemed to see two black and white tail-bitten serpents, joining head to tail, battling, spiraling, weaving something...

At the same time, a sense of ancient vastness surged in Mo Hua’s heart.

Mo Hua felt as though he stood at a boundary of the Great Dao, in eternal life, neither alive nor dead, both illusory and real, like a dream.

But after that, everything vanished.

Mo Hua could feel nothing anymore.

The Wood Revitalization Formation was already inscribed on his bones, fused, transformed into vitality, silently repairing the injuries within Mo Hua caused by inscribing the Lifebound Formation.

Every bit his injuries healed, the Wood Revitalization Formation nourished a bit of vitality, deepening its integration with his body...

Mo Hua’s brows slowly furrowed.

"What is... this thing... fused..."

He tried to probe further, but there was nothing to investigate.

Even the patterns of the Wood Revitalization Formation had merged into the bone, which he could no longer "see."

The Taotie Pattern glowed, allowing him to vaguely see some parts.

But the Wood Revitalization Formation, hidden inside his Twelve regular meridians, once inscribed, operated silently, unnoticed by himself.

Unless he cut open his flesh and extracted his bones, he could see what was inscribed on them.

Only then could he see what changes occurred in the Wood Revitalization Formation.

But that would require he be "dead" one day, dissected, and bones extracted.

Mo Hua repeatedly conducted Divine Sense Internal Observation, checking the flow of Spiritual Power and the operation of formations within himself.

He checked ten times but still detected not a single problem.

Wooden White Gold Jade Bone was healing.

The Taotie Spirit Formation was gradually merging through breath.

The Wood Revitalization Formation was silently nurturing vitality.

All seemed "peaceful."

"No problems..."

Mo Hua pondered again briefly, still discovering nothing unusual, then chose not to dwell on the matter.

This Lifebound Formation was never a traditional inheritance but a patched-up monstrosity by him, so a bit of unforeseen change was indeed normal.

As long as it operates smoothly.

Or rather, Mo Hua merely "prays" this formation system functions without error.

He couldn’t hope for more.

Moreover, the Lifebound Formation was already inscribed, the wood formed into a boat, integrated with his bones, meridians, organs, and blood flesh, affecting everything, with no room for alteration anymore.

Even if there were a problem, he could only pretend it wasn’t there.

Even if he were truly doomed, he could only await death.

Mo Hua steeled his resolve, no longer concerning himself with what may come, conducting another internal observation, confirming the patterns had no errors, formations were running, blood toxins, Wood White essence, golden jade marrow, and some remnant Spiritual Power medicine properties left no residue within.

Then, using Divine Sense, he severed the external and his internal Twelve Meridians’ connection, and with Divine Thought, controlled the Lifebound Formation, stimulating the Wood vitality to heal his flesh.

Thus, his Lifebound Formation completed its final closure.

His formation system, with the Great Wilderness Twelve Classics Taotie Spirit Remains Formation at its core, fortified with Wooden White Gold Jade, and complemented by Wood Revitalization, was fully established...

No further accidents occurred throughout the process.

...

But, unknown miles away.

Taoist State.

In a secluded courtyard.

The Pavilion Elder, sitting by a stream, eyes closed, fishing in a doze, abruptly opened his eyes in bewilderment:

"What happened to my formation..."

"Where’s the formation I gave him?"
